xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DescriptionOfSingleSegment: As the Company business operations fall within a single primary business segment viz product and systems for electricity distribution. The disclosure requirements of Ind AS 108 Operating Segments prescribed under section 133 of the CA 2013 read with relevant rules are not applicable.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Financial Results were reviewed by Audit Committee and approved by Board of Directors at their meeting held on May 26, 2025.
Financial results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards as notified by MCA pursuant to Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 read with rule 3 and relevant amendments made thereunder.
The Chief Operating Decision Maker reviews operations of the Company as a whole i.e. single primary business segment viz product and systems for electricity distribution, hence, there are no reportable segments as per Ind AS 108.
Exceptional items for the current year represent reversal of interest provisions related to past direct tax litigation matters upon application made under Vivad se Vishwas scheme and acceptance thereof by relevant income tax authorities.
Company deferred tax liabilities included those related to revaluation of property, plant and equipment. However, pursuant to the amendments relating to withdrawal of indexation benefits and change in tax rates on long term capital gains per the Finance Act, 2024, the Company has remeasured the deferred tax liabilities which resulted in an overall decrease of Rs. 412 lakh.
The figures for the quarter ended March 31, 2025 and March 31, 2024 are the balancing figures between the audited figures in respect of the full financial year and the published unaudited year to date figures upto the third quarter of the relevant financial year which were subjected to limited review.
Previous period figures have been reclassified or regrouped wherever necessary, to correspond with those of current period classification.
Company has no subsidiary or associate or joint venture company as on March 31, 2025.
